objective_text.T74.02.d: Replace strong retention with weak interning linked to collector epochs, defining when IDs retire and whether reinterned bytes regain the same identity. Delayed assessment retains a symbol across a moving collection and forces an allocation failure during rehash.

objective_text.T74.11.b: Implement transactional map validation and relocation of every root copy, preserving scalar slots and one-past offsets. objective_text.T74.11.c: Enumerate base/destination/offset combinations, exact maps, missing roots, uninitialized slots, missing forwarding and non-safepoint rejection.
